scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
host_fixture: Use existing translation-unit-private collector regression fixture and exact materialized include; root owns all compile/test admission.

required_cases.name: ordered-subsequence-equivalence
required_cases.inputs: Multiple adjacent immutable records with two PIDs each; queries from first line through final line, including gaps and identical line text in multiple records.
required_cases.assert: Original and candidate return/cursor agree; bytes before cursor never rematch; current full byte retention remains byte-identical.

required_cases.name: cursor-boundaries
required_cases.inputs: cursor0; record start; middle exact newline end; record end; next record start; later record end; all previous records exhausted.
required_cases.assert: Same match/no-match; no out-of-record dereference; no file identity checks skipped.

required_cases.name: pid-and-startup-route
required_cases.inputs: PID-specific old traces; pid0 control markers across multiple records; no matching PID; startup-control reuse after ring rollover.
required_cases.assert: Exact ordered authentication preserved; unknown PID/reordered line still rejects.

required_cases.name: identity-failure-before-skipped-bytes
required_cases.inputs: Replace/delete/chmod/link/truncate/retimestamp an old record whose byte range is below cursor, including pid0 traversal.
required_cases.assert: Candidate still returns error in same place and retains existing stat comparison, O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file/link, close behavior.

required_cases.name: whole-save-and-retain
required_cases.inputs: Run exact pair_trace_save and long_retain with previous records plus old-prefix/current-PID snapshot; capture all output bytes and before/after record identity.
required_cases.assert: Exact selected bytes, per-round file bytes, authenticated-memory bytes and spool bytes equal original; current_round state and total unchanged.

required_cases.name: profile-unchanged
required_cases.inputs: Exact cap and just-over-cap retention, maximum round, empty/unterminated/currentthenold snapshot.

required_cases.name: operation-count-regression
required_cases.inputs: A retained record with4096 unique ordered newline lines queried sequentially. Instrument memchr bytes/calls in fixture only; retain all real identity operations.
required_cases.assert: Candidate starts scan at prior match end; original triangular scans vs candidate linear scans; identity syscall calls/order remain identical.

required_cases.name: end-to-end-functional-retry
required_cases.inputs: Fresh root-owned admitted successor after positive retirement and required independent review.
required_cases.assert: New full60continuous mixed work, same strict oracle/full retention; no partial credit from failed run.

resource_profile: No new static memory/FDs, no syscall ownership change, same trace_cap268435456 and wall7200000000000. Collector rebuild/capsule regeneration requires normal root resource slots; no kernel/module rebuild required. Native benefit must be measured.
